clue.text: Tribal character in charge booted out of football team

indicators.note: booted out of says the letters for 'in charge' are kicked out of the team's name

parts.note: Celtic is the Glasgow football club

explanation.surface: A tribesman in charge is sacked from a football club.
explanation.walkthrough: Celtic is a famous Scottish football club in Glasgow.
explanation.definitionFit: A Celt is a member of an ancient tribal people of Europe, hence a tribal character.

clue.text: Company member's allowed to be participating in wrongdoing

clue.text: Angela's cooking savoury dish

parts.note: the name with its S taken as letters

explanation.surface: Angela is making a savoury meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Lasagne is a baked Italian pasta dish with meat or vegetable sauce.

clue.text: Fasten stand after losing time at first

indicators.note: after losing says a letter is taken away from the stand
at first says the lost letter comes from the front of the word

parts.note: a trivet is a three-legged stand for a pot

explanation.surface: Instructions to secure a stand once some time has been lost.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after losing' and 'at first' together drop T from the front of TRIVET.
explanation.definitionFit: To rivet is to fasten with metal pins, a direct verb synonym.

clue.text: Loft extension, say, may be turned over for joint sufferer

indicators.note: say means the phrase is spoken to give the entry
may be turned over swaps the two words of the loft phrase round

parts.note: an attic room, with its two words swapped, room attic

explanation.surface: A loft conversion that might be overturned, for someone with aching joints.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Loft extension' is ATTIC ROOM; 'may be turned over' flips it to ROOM ATTIC, and 'say' tells us that, spoken, it gives the entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A rheumatic person suffers from rheumatism, pain in the joints.

clue.text: With regard to two passport stamps: one missing article

indicators.note: one missing says one of the pair lacks a letter
two says the stamp word is written twice

parts.note: a visa is a passport stamp
A is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Concerning two passport stamps, one of which lacks an item.
explanation.walkthrough: VISA twice gives VISAVISA; losing A from the second leaves VIS-A-VIS.
explanation.definitionFit: Vis-a-vis is French-derived for in relation to, concerning.

clue.text: Interpret second half right — it's less inaccurate

indicators.note: second half takes the closing portion of the verb

parts.note: to construe is to interpret

explanation.surface: Reading only the back half correctly makes a text more accurate.
explanation.walkthrough: The second half of CONSTRUE is TRUE.
explanation.definitionFit: Truer is the comparative of true, so closer to fact, less wrong.

clue.text: Cheaply-built, with crack showing after the Spanish returned

indicators.note: after places the crack behind the turned-round Spanish article
returned means the Spanish word is read backwards

parts.note: EL is Spanish for the
a crack is a go, an attempt

explanation.surface: A shoddy building whose cracks appear once the Spaniards came back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' turns the Spanish article round. The toy brick name used as an adjective for flimsy construction is a stretch, but the wordplay settles it.
explanation.definitionFit: Toy construction bricks suggest something flimsy and slapped together, a loose figurative sense.

clue.text: Money-making vital cure dispensed

indicators.note: dispensed, as medicine by a chemist, suggests the letters are made up anew

explanation.surface: A pharmacist hands out an essential remedy.
explanation.definitionFit: A lucrative business produces plenty of profit.

clue.text: Girl one brought to shelter in place of miracles

I is the Roman numeral one
lee is shelter from the wind

explanation.surface: A girl takes someone to a refuge in a holy place.
explanation.definitionFit: Galilee is the region where the Gospels set many of Jesus's miracles.

clue.text: Shakespeare's fast woman

clue.text: Record spread of stoppage

jam is a spread for bread

explanation.surface: Someone noting how far a blockage has spread.
explanation.definitionFit: A logjam is a blockage or deadlock, literally of floating timber, hence a stoppage.

clue.text: Unstable British settling east of drowned valley, in another valley

clue.text: Transmutational alchemist with no aspiration to be climber

aspiration is the breathed sound written H, so that letter goes

explanation.walkthrough: Removing H from ALCHEMIST leaves ALCEMIST, which is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Clematis is a climbing plant grown up walls and trellises.

clue.text: Wimpy Ltd remake determined by demand

clue.text: Following degree, I was first given a posting

clue.text: Distorted spin has me confused

clue.text: Cutie taking in European clubs then summer in Nice wearing a low-cut dress

clue.text: Galloped into hospital department, being caustic
